description: This file defines a lightweight wrapper class 'LocalPrefs' for interacting with shared preferences in a Flutter application, specifically for managing notification enabled flags.

classes.name: LocalPrefs
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to set and get notification preferences using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: setNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Saves the notification enabled flag to shared preferences.

methods.name: getNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Reads the notification enabled flag from shared preferences, defaults to false if not set.
